task:
Another follow-up Designer visual review. The footer dead-space bug and the broken-image-style placeholder were already fixed by hand (outside this pipeline) - don't touch .site-content/.site-footer flex rules or re-add a Pillow-based placeholder. The faucet icon (catalog/static/catalog/icons/faucet.jpg) was also already regenerated and no longer reads as a letter - no action needed on it. Fix these four remaining, real issues:
1) Stock-availability badge on the product detail page (.product-detail-stock) uses color-success-tint as background, but that tint (#e7f2ea) is so pale it reads as a flat gray/neutral chip rather than a positive status indicator - a buyer can't tell at a glance that 'В наличии' is good news. Increase its visual weight: either a stronger/more saturated tint, a visible border in color-success, or a small dot/check icon - keep the overall palette restrained, don't make it a loud solid-fill badge.
2) On the catalog page, when a category has only 1-2 products the product-grid leaves a large empty block to the right of the cards because the grid stretches to the container's full max-width regardless of item count. Constrain the grid so a sparse row doesn't look like a broken/incomplete layout - e.g. don't stretch grid tracks wider than the card's natural size, or cap the grid's own width based on item count.
3) On the product detail page, the two-column layout (image | title+price+description+stock+form) has a much taller left column than right column on products with short descriptions, leaving a lot of blank space under the right column's content. Rebalance so the composition doesn't read as two independently-sized blocks - e.g. cap/reduce the image column's height to better match typical content height, or vertically center the right column's content against the image.
4) The four home-page category cards currently use identical chrome (same white rounded card, same shadow, same icon-tile treatment) with only the real per-category photo differing - reviewed as a generic templated card pattern. Use the frontend-design skill for direction on giving the row more visual distinction without making categories inconsistent with each other - e.g. revisit the icon tile's framing now that it holds a real photo instead of a flat glyph (the current 56px tinted-box treatment was designed for a single-color icon glyph, not a multi-color photo) rather than only changing colors.
Use the frontend-design skill before touching CSS/templates.
output:

Explicitly scoped out: `.site-content`/`.site-footer` flex rules and `seed_demo.py`'s placeholder logic (already fixed by hand), and `faucet.jpg` (already fine). Prior ticket sections were left untouched.

output:
All four fixes are implemented and tests pass:

1. **Stock badge** — added `border: 1px solid currentColor` and a solid `::before` dot, tracking whichever state color (success green / low-stock accent) is active.
2. **Catalog grid** — switched to `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 240px))` + `justify-content: start`, so sparse rows collapse unused tracks instead of stretching cards into a ghost column.
3. **Product detail layout** — added `align-items: center` to `.product-detail` and capped the image at `max-height: 420px` with `object-fit: cover`, so short-description products no longer leave a tall empty gap.
4. **Category cards** — promoted the 56px icon tile to a full-width 16:9 photo band flush with the card edges, with name/count moved into a new padded `.category-card-body` below — gives each card's real photo room to read as a photo rather than a cropped glyph thumbnail, while keeping all four cards one consistent frame.

Verified via `manage.py check`, the full test suite (32 tests, all passing), and by rendering all three page types against seeded data, including the one single-product category (`Водонагреватели`) to confirm the grid fix. Didn't touch `.site-content`/`.site-footer` flex rules, `seed_demo.py`, or `faucet.jpg`, per the ticket's explicit exclusions.

output:
## Review

**Scope check against DESIGN.md's "round-3 visual fixes" ticket (lines 383–502):** all four flagged items plus the two explicitly out-of-scope items (sticky-footer, Pillow placeholder) were respected.

**1. Stock badge** (`.product-detail-stock`) — `style.css:274-295` adds `border: 1px solid currentColor`, `inline-flex`/`gap`, and a `::before` dot exactly as specified; `.is-low` correctly inherits both via class concatenation (verified in `product_detail.html:18`) with no extra CSS needed. Matches spec.

**2. Product grid** — `grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 240px))` + `justify-content: start` (`style.css:202-206`), matches spec exactly; `auto-fit` collapses empty tracks so a sparse row no longer claims extra width.

**3. Product detail two-column balance** — `align-items: center` added to `.product-detail`, `max-height: 420px` + `object-fit: cover` added to `.product-detail img` (`style.css:250-264`), matches spec exactly.

**4. Home category cards** — restructured to a full-width `aspect-ratio: 16/9` photo band with a new `.category-card-body` wrapper, matching the spec line-for-line (card padding moved, `overflow: hidden` added, icon tile stripped of border/radius/centering, `home.html` wraps name+count in the new body span but leaves the icon outside it). Ran the icons through Read to check the crop risk the automated code-review flagged (44% of frame height lost to the 16:9 crop): all four source images (`pipes.jpg`, `faucet.jpg`, `toilet.jpg`, `heater.jpg`, 1024×1024) are centered compositions with generous symmetric padding, so the center-crop preserves the subject in every case — not visually broken.

Ran the full test suite: 32/32 passing.

**Concerns worth flagging (non-blocking for this ticket):**
- DESIGN.md's round-3 section (newly written this round) asserts the category icons are "real multi-color photography," but visual inspection shows they're flat AI-generated icon illustrations (line art / flat-color glyphs) with large negative-space padding, not photos. The full-bleed photo-band treatment is implemented correctly per that (mistaken) premise and doesn't look broken, but because the subjects don't fill the frame, the band will show more pale background than "bold photography" — this may read as a large pale rectangle with a small centered icon rather than achieving the intended "visual distinction," and could resurface in the next Designer pass.
- The invoked code-review skill also surfaced that the "sticky-footer fix already landed by hand," which both DESIGN.md and this ticket's own instructions assert, does not actually exist anywhere in `style.css`/`base.html` — the prior commit only removed `.site-footer`'s `margin-top: 3rem` with no compensating flex/`min-height` mechanism. This is explicitly out of scope here and I did not touch it, but it means the original dead-space bug is still live and DESIGN.md now tells future tickets not to look at it — worth correcting the documentation so it doesn't get permanently fenced off.
- Minor cleanliness only: `--color-placeholder-bg`/`--color-placeholder-icon` tokens are now unreferenced, and `.category-card-count` keeps a leftover `inline-flex`/`align-items` with no flex children — neither affects rendering.

None of these are implementation errors against this ticket's design doc — all four required changes match DESIGN.md precisely and are verified correct.

VERDICT: PASS
